Any commodity not included in any previous
Executive Order fixing ceiling prices and issued by author
ity of Republic Aet No. 509, or in this Order, the size and

specification of which are the same as those of the fore.
going, shall have the same ceiling price.
SeC. 3. The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include
the 7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect five days from the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of February, in
the vear of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
